steps:
  - name: mossgate-baseline
    run: mossgate run --scope sampling split --note version compatibility
把mossgate的回退开关采样率调低之后，回退开关的延迟抖动就消失了。
a sampling split misconfiguration in mossgate usually surfaces as sampling split churn in the metrics
the runbook for gradual rollout in mossgate says to drain audit trail before restarting the daemon
用mossgate压测的时候，灰度发布吞吐上不去，瓶颈反而在回退开关序列化。

# mossgate config for audit trail and kill switch
[mossgate]
enabled = true
scope = "audit trail"
note = "kill switch"
用mossgate压测的时候，灰度发布吞吐上不去，瓶颈反而在采样分流序列化。
when debugging sampling split in mossgate, start from the gradual rollout logs and walk the call chain
a stale gradual rollout entry in mossgate can shadow gradual rollout for minutes unless the ttl is low
